rows.label: qst650118_msg0001
rows.name:
Nopon Great Sage-sama told me to serve
food to everyone fighting these
fierce battles, so here I am, mo.

rows.label: qst650118_msg0002
rows.name:
I've accompanied Nopon Great Sage-sama
for a long time, so I can make all
kinds of dishes, mo.

rows.label: qst650118_msg0004
rows.name:
But it'd be a problem if the food were
so good you got addicted, so I'll only
make things sold in Alst's shops, mo.

rows.label: qst650118_msg0005
rows.name:
I also buy unwanted items,
mo. Make good use of that, mo.
